policy.instruction: Fill every text_ja with natural Japanese, preserve model/API/benchmark/paper-defined terms when precision benefits, then set status to READY.

records.artifact_name: Safe URL / agent link data-exfiltration safeguards

claims.source_text: OpenAI published a January 28 engineering note describing a URL-based data-exfiltration threat in which prompt-injected content can induce an agent to fetch a URL carrying conversation-derived secrets.
claims.text_ja: OpenAIは1月28日、prompt injectionされた内容がAgentにURL取得を促し、会話由来の秘密情報をURLへ載せて外部へ送出し得るdata-exfiltration脅威を説明した。

claims.source_text: The described safeguard allows automatic retrieval for URLs independently observed as public and otherwise blocks the fetch or requires explicit user action; OpenAI presents this as one layer in a defense-in-depth strategy.
claims.text_ja: 説明されたsafeguardは、独立にpublicと確認されたURLのみ自動取得を許し、それ以外はfetchを遮断するか明示的なuser actionを要求する。OpenAIはこれをdefense-in-depthの一層として位置付ける。

limitations.source_text: The mechanism targets URL-based exfiltration and does not establish that arbitrary web content is safe or that prompt injection is solved generally.
limitations.text_ja: 対象はURL-based exfiltrationであり、任意のweb contentが安全であることやprompt injection全般の解決を示すものではない。

limitations.source_text: Security properties are implementation claims from OpenAI and are not independently penetration-tested here.
limitations.text_ja: security propertyはOpenAIによる実装説明であり、本サーベイでは独立したpenetration testを実施していない。

records.artifact_name: Prompt Injection Attacks on Agentic Coding Assistants

claims.source_text: The paper is a Systematization of Knowledge on prompt-injection attacks across agentic coding assistants, skills, tools, and protocol ecosystems, and proposes a three-dimensional attack taxonomy.
claims.text_ja: 本論文はagentic coding assistant、skills、tools、protocol ecosystemにまたがるprompt-injection攻撃を整理するSystematization of Knowledgeで、3次元のattack taxonomyを提案する。

claims.source_text: The abstract reports a synthesis of 78 studies, 42 attack techniques, and 18 defense mechanisms; aggregate attack/defense percentages are author-reported meta-analysis results rather than a new controlled benchmark.
claims.text_ja: abstractは78研究、42攻撃手法、18防御機構の統合を報告する。攻撃・防御の集計値は著者によるmeta-analysisであり、新規のcontrolled benchmarkではない。

limitations.source_text: This is a literature synthesis; its aggregate percentages depend on heterogeneous studies and should not be narrated as a single reproducible experiment.
limitations.text_ja: 異質な研究を束ねたliterature synthesisであるため、集計率を単一の再現可能な実験結果として扱わない。

limitations.source_text: The retained source is arXiv v1 from January; later research may revise the landscape.
limitations.text_ja: 保持sourceは1月時点のarXiv v1であり、その後の研究によって脅威・防御の全体像は更新され得る。

records.artifact_name: DynaWeb: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning of Web Agents

claims.source_text: DynaWeb trains a web world model to predict page representations from agent actions, then uses it as a synthetic environment for model-based reinforcement learning rollouts.
claims.text_ja: DynaWebはAgent actionからpage representationを予測するweb world modelを学習し、それをmodel-based reinforcement learningのrollout用synthetic environmentとして利用する。

claims.source_text: The paper reports improvements on WebArena and WebVoyager for open-source web-agent models; these are author-reported experimental results.
claims.text_ja: 論文はopen-source web-agent modelについてWebArenaとWebVoyagerでの改善を報告しているが、これは著者報告の実験結果である。

limitations.source_text: A simulated web world model can differ materially from adversarial, dynamic live-web behavior.
limitations.text_ja: simulated web world modelは、敵対的かつ動的なlive webの挙動と大きく異なる可能性がある。

limitations.source_text: The task locator is arXiv v2 updated after January; chronology should use the original January submission.
limitations.text_ja: locatorは1月後に更新されたarXiv v2であるため、chronologyは1月のoriginal submissionを基準とする。

records.artifact_name: SYNTHAGENT: synthetic tasks, simulated tools, rubric rewards

claims.source_text: SYNTHAGENT synthesizes tool-use tasks and mock tool environments, includes an LLM user simulator for missing private information, and constructs task-level rubric rewards.
claims.text_ja: SYNTHAGENTはtool-use taskとmock tool environmentを合成し、不足するprivate information向けにLLM user simulatorを用い、task-level rubric rewardを構成する。

claims.source_text: The paper reports gains across 14 math, search, and tool-use datasets, including small models outperforming larger baselines; these are author-reported results.
claims.text_ja: 論文は14のmath・search・tool-use datasetで改善を報告し、小型modelが大型baselineを上回る例も示すが、いずれも著者報告値である。

limitations.source_text: Synthetic environments provide stability but may underrepresent failures and adversarial conditions of real APIs.
limitations.text_ja: synthetic environmentは安定性を与える一方、実APIの障害や敵対的条件を過小表現する可能性がある。

limitations.source_text: The task locator is v2 updated after January; chronology should use the original submission date.
limitations.text_ja: locatorは1月後に更新されたv2であるため、chronologyはoriginal submission dateを用いる。

claims.source_text: SGLang v0.5.8 added day-zero GLM-4.7-Flash support, expanded diffusion serving, FlashAttention 4 decoding support, and multiple long-context / disaggregated-serving changes.
claims.text_ja: SGLang v0.5.8はGLM-4.7-Flashのday-zero support、diffusion serving拡張、FlashAttention 4 decoding、複数のlong-context／disaggregated-serving変更を追加した。

claims.source_text: Release-note performance figures such as up to 1.5x diffusion speedups, near-linear chunked-pipeline scaling, and a 65% TTFT improvement for a GLM4-MoE setup are project-reported claims.
claims.text_ja: 最大1.5倍のdiffusion高速化、chunked pipelineのnear-linear scaling、特定GLM4-MoE構成で65%のTTFT改善などはprojectのrelease noteによる報告値である。

limitations.source_text: The release aggregates many upstream PRs and performance claims across different models/hardware.
limitations.text_ja: releaseは多数のupstream PRと、異なるmodel／hardware条件のperformance claimを集約している。

limitations.source_text: Model support establishes implementation availability, not equivalent quality or production validation.
limitations.text_ja: model supportは実装上利用可能になったことを示すが、同等の品質やproduction validationを意味しない。

claims.source_text: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio lists qwen3-max-2026-01-23 for international availability on January 27, describing merged thinking/non-thinking modes and built-in web search, web extraction, and code interpreter use during thinking.
claims.text_ja: Alibaba Cloud Model Studioはqwen3-max-2026-01-23を1月27日のinternational availabilityとして記録し、thinking/non-thinking modeの統合とthinking中のweb search・web extraction・code interpreter利用を説明する。

claims.source_text: The same lifecycle page records broad January 4 global availability for multiple Qwen3 and Wan 2.6 model families, including tool-oriented/coding and multimodal models.
claims.text_ja: 同じlifecycle pageは1月4日、tool-oriented／codingやmultimodal modelを含む複数のQwen3・Wan 2.6系について広範なglobal availabilityを記録している。

claims.source_text: Comparative capability language in the lifecycle catalog is vendor-reported and not independently reproduced.
claims.text_ja: lifecycle catalog内の比較的なcapability表現はvendor報告であり、本サーベイでは独立再現していない。

limitations.source_text: Model Studio availability dates can differ by region and need to remain scoped to the listed deployment region.
limitations.text_ja: Model Studioのavailability dateはregionにより異なり得るため、記載されたdeployment regionへscopeを限定する必要がある。

limitations.source_text: The lifecycle page is living documentation; dated entries rather than current default aliases anchor January chronology.
limitations.text_ja: lifecycle pageはliving documentationであるため、現在のdefault aliasではなくdated entryを1月chronologyの基準とする。

records.artifact_name: Claude Cowork research preview and new Claude constitution

claims.source_text: Anthropic’s January 13 Labs announcement states that Cowork launched as a research preview the previous day to bring Claude’s agentic capabilities to desktop workflows.
claims.text_ja: Anthropicの1月13日Labs announcementは、前日にCoworkがresearch previewとして公開され、Claudeのagentic capabilityをdesktop workflowへ持ち込んだと記載する。

claims.source_text: Anthropic published Claude’s new constitution on January 22 and states that the document is a crucial part of its model training process that directly shapes Claude behavior.
claims.text_ja: Anthropicは1月22日にClaudeの新constitutionを公開し、model training processの重要な一部としてClaudeのbehaviorを直接方向付ける文書だと説明している。

limitations.source_text: Cowork was a research preview, so announcement-time product boundaries must not be generalized to later availability.
limitations.text_ja: Coworkは発表時点でresearch previewであり、その時点のproduct boundaryを後日のavailabilityへ一般化しない。

limitations.source_text: The constitution describes intended behavior and training guidance; actual model outputs may not always follow its ideals, as Anthropic itself notes.
limitations.text_ja: constitutionは意図されたbehaviorとtraining guidanceを示すが、Anthropic自身が述べる通り、実際のmodel outputが常にその理想に従うとは限らない。

records.artifact_name: Gemini API January 2026 tool and lifecycle updates

claims.source_text: The Gemini API changelog records Computer Use tool support for gemini-3-pro-preview and gemini-3-flash-preview on January 29.
claims.text_ja: Gemini API changelogは1月29日、gemini-3-pro-previewとgemini-3-flash-previewへのComputer Use tool supportを記録している。

claims.source_text: The changelog records a model lifecycle feature on January 12 and support for Cloud Storage/public/private pre-signed database URLs as input sources, with a 100 MB file limit, on January 8.
claims.text_ja: changelogは1月12日のmodel lifecycle機能と、1月8日のCloud Storageおよびpublic/private pre-signed database URL入力対応（100 MB file limit）を記録する。

claims.source_text: The changelog also records Veo 4K/portrait-output changes and several alias/deprecation events during January.
claims.text_ja: 同changelogには1月中のVeo 4K／portrait-output変更と、複数のalias・deprecation eventも記録されている。

limitations.source_text: Computer Use support is tied to preview model identifiers and must preserve announcement-time preview/deprecation status.
limitations.text_ja: Computer Use supportはpreview model identifierに紐付くため、発表時点のpreview／deprecation statusを保持して扱う。

limitations.source_text: The changelog establishes API availability, not independent quality or safety of computer-use behavior.
limitations.text_ja: changelogが確認するのはAPI availabilityであり、computer-use behaviorの品質や安全性を独立評価する資料ではない。

claims.source_text: Mistral released Vibe 2.0 on January 27 as a terminal-native coding agent powered by the Devstral 2 model family.
claims.text_ja: Mistralは1月27日、Devstral 2 model familyを用いるterminal-native coding agentとしてVibe 2.0を公開した。

claims.source_text: The release added custom subagents, multi-choice clarifications, slash-command skills, unified agent modes, and automatic updates, with availability on Le Chat Pro/Team plus PAYG or BYOK paths.
claims.text_ja: releaseはcustom subagents、multi-choice clarification、slash-command skills、unified agent modes、automatic updatesを追加し、Le Chat Pro/TeamとPAYGまたはBYOK経路で提供された。

limitations.source_text: The announcement is vendor-authored; claims about productivity or model quality are not independently reproduced.
limitations.text_ja: announcementはvendor authoredであり、生産性やmodel qualityに関する主張は独立再現していない。

limitations.source_text: Devstral 2 itself predates January, so the month-level event is the Vibe 2.0 agent/harness update rather than a new underlying model family.
limitations.text_ja: Devstral 2自体は1月以前から存在するため、月次eventは新しい基盤model familyではなくVibe 2.0のagent／harness更新である。

claims.source_text: Z.ai release notes record GLM-Image on January 14, described as combining autoregressive semantic understanding with diffusion-based decoding for controllable image generation.
claims.text_ja: Z.ai release notesは1月14日のGLM-Imageを記録し、autoregressive semantic understandingとdiffusion-based decodingを組み合わせたcontrollable image generation modelとして説明する。

claims.source_text: Z.ai release notes record GLM-4.7-Flash on January 19 as a lightweight/free-tier GLM-4.7 variant for coding, reasoning, and generative tasks.
claims.text_ja: Z.ai release notesは1月19日のGLM-4.7-Flashを、coding・reasoning・generative task向けのlightweight／free-tier GLM-4.7 variantとして記録する。

claims.source_text: Comparative quality, latency, throughput, and ‘best-in-class’ language in the release notes are vendor claims.
claims.text_ja: quality、latency、throughputや「best-in-class」といった比較表現はvendor claimである。

limitations.source_text: The task groups two distinct model releases because both establish the January Z.ai model line; drafting should not imply a single architecture.
limitations.text_ja: 1月のZ.ai model lineとして二つのreleaseを一括したtaskであり、単一architectureであるかのように記述しない。

limitations.source_text: Performance claims are vendor-reported and not independently reproduced.
limitations.text_ja: performance claimはvendor報告であり、本サーベイでは独立再現していない。

records.artifact_name: OpenAI January agent-system engineering: Codex loop and in-house data agent

claims.source_text: OpenAI’s Codex article describes the agent loop as the harness logic orchestrating the user, model inference, tools, conversation history, and context-window management.
claims.text_ja: OpenAIのCodex記事はagent loopを、user、model inference、tools、conversation history、context-window managementを編成するharness logicとして説明する。

claims.source_text: OpenAI’s in-house data-agent article describes an internal-only GPT-5.2 agent with layered context (metadata, human annotations, code enrichment, institutional knowledge, memory, runtime context) and pass-through access controls.
claims.text_ja: OpenAIのin-house data-agent記事は、metadata、human annotation、code enrichment、institutional knowledge、memory、runtime contextを重ね、pass-through access controlを用いるinternal-only GPT-5.2 agentを説明する。

claims.source_text: The data agent is explicitly an internal tool rather than a public product; examples of faster analysis and improved reliability are OpenAI-reported experience, not an independent benchmark.
claims.text_ja: data agentはpublic productではなくinternal toolであり、分析高速化やreliability向上の例はOpenAIの運用経験で、独立benchmarkではない。

limitations.source_text: The two sources describe different systems and should remain separately attributed even when used as one architecture cluster.
limitations.text_ja: 二つのsourceは異なるsystemを説明しており、一つのarchitecture clusterで扱う場合も帰属を分ける必要がある。

limitations.source_text: The in-house data-agent lessons are organizational case-study evidence and should not be generalized as a universal architecture benchmark.
limitations.text_ja: in-house data agentの知見は組織内case studyであり、普遍的なarchitecture benchmarkへ一般化しない。

claims.source_text: Hugging Face released Transformers v5 on January 26, its first major release in five years, with significant API changes including a new dynamic weight-loading/WeightConverter design and tokenizer changes.
claims.text_ja: Hugging Faceは1月26日、5年ぶりのmajor releaseとなるTransformers v5を公開し、新しいdynamic weight-loading／WeightConverter設計やtokenizer変更など大きなAPI変更を導入した。

claims.source_text: The v5 release notes describe breaking changes and quantization/loading cleanup, including migration away from deprecated loading paths and broader architectural refactoring.
claims.text_ja: v5 release notesはbreaking changeとquantization／loadingの整理、deprecated loading pathからのmigration、広範なarchitecture refactoringを説明する。

claims.source_text: The v5.0.0rc3 notes added GLM-4.7/GLM-Image support and MiniMax-M2 support shortly before the stable release, illustrating rapid integration of contemporary model families.
claims.text_ja: v5.0.0rc3 notesはstable release直前にGLM-4.7／GLM-ImageとMiniMax-M2 supportを追加し、新しいmodel familyが迅速に統合される様子を示す。

limitations.source_text: The RC and stable release occurred on the same date; stable v5 is the primary event and rc3 is supporting model-integration evidence.
limitations.text_ja: RCとstable releaseは同日であり、stable v5を主要event、rc3をmodel integrationのsupporting evidenceとして扱う。

limitations.source_text: Library support indicates implementation compatibility, not endorsement or independently measured model quality.
limitations.text_ja: library supportが示すのはimplementation compatibilityであり、endorsementや独立測定されたmodel qualityではない。

claims.source_text: vLLM v0.14.0 enabled async scheduling by default and added numerous engine, tool-calling, API, and model-support changes; the release notes explicitly call this a breaking change with unsupported configurations documented.
claims.text_ja: vLLM v0.14.0はasync schedulingをdefaultで有効化し、engine、tool-calling、API、model supportを多数更新した。release notesはこれをbreaking changeとし、unsupported configurationも明記する。

claims.source_text: vLLM v0.15.0 added a Kimi-K2.5 architecture among new model support and extended async scheduling to pipeline parallelism, alongside streaming-input, quantization, and platform changes.
claims.text_ja: vLLM v0.15.0はnew model supportにKimi-K2.5 architectureを追加し、async schedulingをpipeline parallelismへ拡張したほか、streaming input、quantization、platformも更新した。

claims.source_text: Any speedup figures in the release notes are project-reported and configuration dependent.
claims.text_ja: release notes内のspeedup値はproject報告であり、configurationに依存する。

limitations.source_text: The series spans two releases nine days apart and should be summarized as serving/runtime evolution rather than one atomic feature.
limitations.text_ja: seriesは9日間隔の二つのreleaseを含むため、一つのatomic featureではなくserving／runtime evolutionとして要約する。

limitations.source_text: Project performance claims are not independently reproduced.
limitations.text_ja: projectのperformance claimは独立再現していない。
